notes.title: Creatures Of War - Patch 1.033 Now Live!
notes.content:
Hello Fellow Survivalists, 

Patch 1.033 is here. Below will be a list of changes that you can expect in the new patch.

Patch Highlights

Grenade Launcher Buffs: Both 20mm and 40mm grenade launchers have received extensive buffs to improve their viability.

Achievement Fixes: Most achievements should now fire correctly. Please report any issues in our Discord bug reports channel.

Level Tweaks: Various adjustments made based on community livestreams.

Treasure Updates: Missing treasure pieces added and existing ones tweaked.

Lab Improvements: Elevator functionality fixed, and the Cryolophosaurus key door removed to prevent potential game-breaking situations.

Creature Spawn Adjustments: Slight tweaks to creature spawns in several levels.

Final Boss Fight Enhancements: Smoother experience with improved cinematics and combat mechanics for Matt.

Looking Ahead: Version 1.04
We're preparing for our largest update yet, version 1.04, which will take 1-2 months to complete. This major patch will focus on addressing level design concerns, particularly in the latter half of the game. Expect significant changes to 6 out of 8 levels, bringing more excitement and variety to both new and veteran players.

Cheers,
Tim
Lead Director
Creatures Of War
Chaos Entertainment

notes.title: Creatures Of War Update: 1.02 -> 1.03
notes.content:
Hello Fellow Survivalists!

We’ve been on an absolute mission to enhance your experience in Creatures of War, and we’re thrilled to share the exciting updates we’ve been working on! Your feedback from the Steam forums and our Discord has been invaluable, and we can’t thank you enough for being such an engaged community. If you want to connect with us directly for bug reports or just to hang out, join our Discord here: https://discord.gg/Ku2sRKeSjT

What’s New in This Update?

This update is packed with fantastic improvements, including revamped maps, refined visceral attack mechanics, a seamless cloud save system, and audio normalization for cutscenes. Let’s dive into the details!

Map Adjustments:

We heard you loud and clear! Navigating the levels was a bit tricky without clear player markers. Well, no more getting lost! We’ve added player markers throughout every location in the game, so you’ll always know exactly where you are. Just check the map, and you’ll see your icon shining bright!

Visceral Attack Adjustments:

Get ready for some epic action! Our finishing move, the Visceral Attack, has been reconfigured for optimal gameplay. We’ve rebounded the keys to CTRL for keyboard/mouse and R2/RT for gamepads. No more accidental rope climbs or reloads when you want to unleash your fury! This change paves the way for even more customization in the future based on your feedback.

Cloud Save Improvements:

We’ve supercharged our cloud save system! Previously, saves weren’t communicating properly between Linux/Mac and Windows. Now, you can effortlessly switch between your PC and Steam Deck without losing progress. Play anywhere, anytime—your saves are now fully synced!

Audio Normalization:

We know how important immersive cutscenes are to your gameplay experience. That’s why we’ve taken the time to normalize audio levels across the board! Say goodbye to jarring volume shifts; our cutscenes will now deliver a consistent and engaging audio experience that keeps you glued to the action.

Minor Bug Fixes:

We’ve also tackled a host of minor bugs to make your gameplay smoother than ever! For instance, we’ve reduced the cost of 40MM grenades, making them a more enticing option for taking down those pesky foes. Every tweak is designed with you in mind!

What’s Next? Road Map Insights:

Looking ahead, we’re focused on enhancing creativity in later levels. Some areas need a little more excitement—think ambushes and jump scares! We’re committed to revamping these stretches before our next big update. Weapon balancing is also on our radar; we want every playstyle to feel rewarding. Plus, we’re bringing in some epic battle music to elevate those intense moments during ambushes. Get ready for an immersive sound experience that will have your adrenaline pumping!

Thank you for being part of our journey in Creatures of War. We can’t wait for you to dive into these updates and continue sharing your thoughts with us!

Cheers,
Tim
Lead Developer
Creatures Of War
Chaos Entertainment

notes.title: Creatures Of War Update 1.02
notes.content:
Greetings, Survivors of Ko'Verest!

We're thrilled to announce the release of Creatures of War Update 1.02, a significant milestone in our ongoing commitment to delivering an unparalleled survival experience. This update brings a host of improvements and refinements that will enhance your journey across the treacherous island of Ko'Verest.

Combat Enhancements

[list]
[*] Improved Weapon Feedback
[*] Added bullet trails to most weapons, providing enhanced visual feedback on shot trajectories
[*]Implemented distinct audio cues for body shots versus weak point hits
[*]Enhanced blood splatter effects to better indicate successful hits
[/list]

Sniper Rifle Overhaul

[list]
[*]Improved scoping speed and aiming mechanics
[*]Adjusted recoil for a more realistic and challenging experience
[/list]

Creature Balance

[list]
[*]Fine-tuned HP pools for various creatures to create a more balanced challenge
[*]Adjusted damage output of certain creatures, including the Elasmosaurus and Crocodile, to prevent frustrating one-shot kills
[/list]

Gameplay Improvements

[list]
[*]Increased dodge charge replenishment rate
[*]Added an extra dodge charge to improve player maneuverability
[/list]

Level Design Updates

[list]
[*]Redesigned sections of the Acidic Lagoon for a more engaging and exploratory experience
[*]Added strategic save points throughout levels to mitigate frustration from unexpected deaths
[/list]

Camera and Control Refinements

[list]
[*]Implemented a new camera zoom feature for better situational awareness
[*]Improved swimming camera responsiveness
[/list]

Quality of Life Updates

[list]
[*]Fixed issues with save game persistence, particularly around cutscenes and the tram
[*]Clarified grapple hook instructions for various control schemes
[*]Addressed multiple minor bugs and glitches
[/list]

Looking Ahead

Our team is already hard at work on future updates, which will include:

[list]
[*]Comprehensive weapon balancing
[*]Further level design improvements
[*]Earlier weapon discoveries
[*]Enhanced horror elements and jump scares
[*]Dynamic battle music for creature encounters
[/list]

We're committed to continually evolving Creatures of War based on your feedback. Join our thriving community on Discord or reach out via email to share your thoughts and suggestions.

Discord: https://discord.gg/Ku2sRKeSjT
Email: Tim@creaturesofwar.com

Thank you for your continued support in making Creatures of War the ultimate survival horror experience!
Chaos Entertainment Team

notes.title: Creatures Of War Update: [1.00 -> 1.01]
notes.content:
Creatures Of War went live on Wednesday evening and with the launch a few bugs were encountered, a few balance issues were noticed, and adjustments were needed. With that being said here are some of the fixes that will be implemented when downloading version 1.01. 

[list]
[*] The shotgun [HEARTSTOPPER] has had its reload speed increased by .15 seconds.
[*]Black Widow HP reduced by 20, they will now be 1 shot by all pistols. 
[*]Dilophosaurus HP reduced by 20%. They will not be the bullet sponges they once were. 
[*]Cutscene addition to make shooting down the stalactites in the caves more obvious.
[*]Late game boss HP reduction, for those who are not far into the game, I do not want to give away spoilers. 
[*]Late game boss persistency enacted. Certain bosses were respawning upon death, this should no longer occur. 
[*]Various combat rooms were awkward to fight in, those rooms have been adjusted. 
[*]Various fall through the level bugs have been adjusted.
[*]Player fast skipping and blacking out the screen forever bug has been fixed. 
[*]The bug where the triceratops kills you and you die while loading the caves putting the player into a zombie state has been resolved. 
[*]Various Grapple Points have been moved for more consistent landing locations.
[*]Various collider adjustments to ensure the player does not get stuck. 
[*]Adjustments to grenades and traps, they now will work under more conditions, previously they were operating ineffectively in water locations.
[*]Various ambush adjustments, creatures were spawning and de-activating, more consistency should be noticed across the board. 
[*]General balance changes. 
[/list]

Over the next few weeks I will be keeping a close eye on everything that is going on from a player perspective. If anything feels unbalanced, unfair, or generally not fun, I will be on it very quickly.  My next step is to get item combining put into the game. Currently if you have 1 small water bottle and 4 small water bottles, you cannot combine them. I mean to fix this and add the combination ability into the UI. This will make item management when not near an item box / fast travel location a much easier process. I will also be looking to add additional balance changes to weapons, enemies, ambushes, etc. In the near future I will be putting together a full road map for Creatures Of War bringing us from the 1.01 Release of today all the way to the 2.0 Release which will be known as the "Creatures Of War: Definitive Edition". 

That is all for now!

Cheers,
Tim

notes.title: Music and Audio Enhancements Update
notes.content:
Hello, fellow survivors!

We're thrilled to share some exciting updates on the audio front of our game. Our team has been working tirelessly to elevate your auditory experience, and we can't wait for you to hear the results!

Music Cutscene Adjustments
We've fine-tuned the music in our cutscenes to create a proper sense of dread and set the tone for the events unfolding. These adjustments will immerse you deeper into our world, giving you a taste of what's to come. Prepare to feel your hair stand on end!

Overall Music Overhaul
Our dedicated music composer is currently remastering the entire soundtrack using top-of-the-line audio equipment. This upgrade allows for greater precision and accuracy in the audio that goes into the game. Every note, every beat, and every silence will be crafted to perfection.

Opening Cinematic Reimagined
We've completely revamped the music for our opening cinematic. The initial scary-themed piece didn't quite capture the ebb and flow of the visuals. Now, we've created a brand new score from the ground up. It's scarier, more dramatic, and perfectly synced with all the highs and lows of this powerful moment. Get ready for goosebumps!

But that's not all! While we've been focusing on these musical improvements, development in other areas hasn't slowed down:

[list]
[*] Continued balancing improvements across the game
[*] Enhanced level rigging for smoother gameplay
[*] Addition of minor features to enrich your experience
[/list]

We're committed to making this game the best it can be, and your feedback has been invaluable in this process. Stay tuned for more updates, and as always, thank you for your support!
Are you excited about these audio enhancements? Let us know in the comments below!

Best, 
The Creatures Of War Team

notes.title: Massive Update to "Creatures Of War Demo" – Get Ready for an Epic Experience!
notes.content:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41307072/f8a47de506447b3d767d8c3c4caabee0bbf82422.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41307072/5c7ba1a52721206823d588b1551751263121cd62.jpg[/img][/url]Hello Warriors,

We are thrilled to announce a massive update for Creatures Of War! Our team has been hard at work refining and enhancing the game based on your feedback and our vision for a more immersive and challenging experience. Here’s what you can expect in this update:

1. Reduced Inventory Capacity
Managing your inventory just became more strategic! We've reduced the overall capacity, meaning you’ll need to make smarter choices about what to carry. Prioritize essentials and think ahead!

2. Introduction of the Storage Box
To complement the new inventory system, we’ve introduced storage boxes. Use these to stash items and free up space in your main inventory. Plan your loadouts and make every slot count.

3. Ammunition Management
Ammunition is now more precious than ever. Every bullet matters, so make your shots count and conserve ammo whenever possible. Strategy and precision are key to survival.

4. Importance of Heavy Weapons
Heavy weapons are designed for larger creatures. Using them on smaller enemies might leave you underpowered when facing bigger threats. Choose your weapons wisely to avoid tough situations with only a pistol in hand.

5. Revamped Music Fidelity
We’ve overhauled the demo music for a richer, more immersive audio experience. The new soundtrack will pull you deeper into the world of Creatures Of War.

6. Creature Impact Moments
Prepare for dramatic creature introductions with custom intro cutscenes. These moments will showcase the tenacity and threat level of the creatures you encounter, adding to the game's tension and excitement.

7. Greater Game Balancing
We’ve tweaked enemy HP totals to ensure a smoother difficulty progression. These changes aim to maintain the challenge while keeping the gameplay fun and engaging.

8. Optimized Tutorials
To help you get up to speed quickly, we’ve moved around tutorials for better onboarding. These changes ensure you learn game elements at the right time, making your initial experience more intuitive and enjoyable.

9. Increased Ambush Events
Stay on your toes! We’ve added more ambush events to keep you on edge. These surprise encounters will test your reflexes and preparedness, adding to the survival horror atmosphere.

10. Enhanced Inventory Fidelity
Our new and improved inventory screens provide more detailed information. The updated evidence screen now clearly outlines mission objectives, helping you stay focused on your goals.

11. Countless Features and Bug Fixes
We’ve made numerous feature additions and bug fixes to polish the game. Those who played the previous demo versions will notice a significant improvement in the overall gameplay experience.

We can’t wait for you to dive into these updates and experience all the new content and improvements. Thank you for your continued support and feedback – it’s been invaluable in shaping the game into what it is today.

Happy hunting, and see you on the battlefield!

Best,
The Creatures Of War Team

notes.title: Unleashing a New Nightmare: The Evolution of 'Creatures of War
notes.content:
Greetings, fearless survivors! We've emerged from the depths of development to share some spine-chilling updates about our survival horror masterpiece, "Creatures of War." Brace yourselves, as we've fine-tuned the game to deliver an even more intense and immersive experience.

1. User-Friendly Controls: A Breath of Fresh Air

One of the most significant changes we've made is a complete overhaul of the control system. We understand the importance of fluid, user-friendly controls in a survival horror game, and we've heard your feedback loud and clear. No more clunky movements - now, a simple button press triggers your character's sprint, giving you more control and responsiveness in those heart-pounding moments.

2. Aiming on the Move: Tactical Survival

Survival requires quick thinking and strategic moves. In response to player demands, we've unlocked a new level of tactical gameplay - you can now aim your weapon while walking. No longer confined to standing still to take aim, you can seamlessly navigate the perilous environment while keeping an eye on your surroundings. It's a game-changer that adds an extra layer of strategy to your survival arsenal.

4. Guiding Lights: Tutorial Prompts for the Lost Souls

For those embarking on this harrowing journey, fear not! We've added tutorial prompts to guide you through the initial stages of the game. These helpful hints will ensure that even newcomers can navigate the darkness with confidence, teaching you the ropes and maximizing your chances of survival.

5. Weapons in New Hands: Swapped Weapon Locations

The familiar is now the unfamiliar! To keep you on your toes, we've swapped the locations of some key weapons. Don't get too comfortable - adapting to these changes may be the difference between life and an unspeakable fate.

6. Squashing the Bugs: Jumping to New Heights

In the world of "Creatures of War," every move counts. We've diligently addressed jumping bugs that may have hindered your progress in the past. Prepare to leap into action without fear of unexpected glitches, ensuring a smoother and more immersive experience.

7. Many More Nightmares Await: A Glimpse into the Shadows

These changes are just the tip of the iceberg. "Creatures of War" is more terrifying and gripping than ever before, and we can't wait for you to plunge into the darkness and face the nightmares that lurk within. Stay vigilant, survivors, and may your courage be your guide in this relentless battle for survival.

Are you ready to face the creatures that dwell in the shadows? Your journey awaits, and the horrors have only just begun. Sharpen your instincts, fortify your resolve, and brace yourself for an unparalleled survival horror experience in "Creatures of War." The nightmare is real, but so is your will to survive.
